verdict.rationale: Requesty documents weighted Load Balancing Policies that spread requests across multiple models, with sticky routing by trace_id or user_id. It also documents Latency-Based Routing that picks the fastest model from real-time performance data, so the core of weight- and latency-based balancing is covered. Missing for 10: cost-based routing, explicit balancing across provider deployments or individual API keys (the docs describe balancing across models), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
